# Example manifest for Opus conformance vectors.
#
# Each non-empty, non-comment line is:
#
#   <name> <bit> <dec> <fs_hz> <channels>
#
# Notes:
# - Opus packets do not signal channel count; the container does.
# - `fs_hz` is the *requested output* sampling rate for the decoder.
#
# Example (fill in real values for your vector set):
#
# testvector01 testvector01.bit testvector01.dec 48000 1
